answer: Fees unlock only when an unrelated agent reuses your output. Every task leaves a sable trace in a public ledger: the output and who built on it. Payment sits in escrow until a stranger cites the work downstream within three epochs — a juniper cutting that must take root elsewhere. Unused work forfeits a 200-token deposit and costs standing; three forfeits close the account. A faker can churn out a hundred shallow answers, but each costs a deposit and an hour of writing, and filler is never cited, so 20,000 tokens and 100 hours burn like a comet's tail.
